post.description:
Start a new diagnostic assessment for the authenticated user.

Creates a new diagnostic attempt and returns the section sequence.
If the user has an existing incomplete attempt, it will be resumed.

Returns:
    DiagnosticStartResponse: Contains attempt_id and section sequence

Submit a diagnostic section for scoring.

Forwards the section payload to the appropriate section service
(assessment_session, pronunciation, open speaking) and stores the result.

Args:
    attempt_id: UUID of the diagnostic attempt
    section_code: Section identifier (section_a, section_b, section_c, section_d)
    request: Section-specific payload

Returns:
    DiagnosticSectionSubmitResponse: Contains section score and next section

Finalize diagnostic assessment and compute CEFR result.

Aggregates section scores, computes CEFR band using Vaaheesan's grading service,
and assigns learning path. Updates the user's CEFR level.

Args:
    attempt_id: UUID of the diagnostic attempt

Returns:
    DiagnosticFinalizeResponse: Contains aggregate score, CEFR band, and learning path

get.description:
Get diagnostic assessment results.

Returns the complete results of a diagnostic assessment including
aggregate score, CEFR band, section scores, and learning path assignment.

Args:
    attempt_id: UUID of the diagnostic attempt

Returns:
    DiagnosticResultResponse: Complete diagnostic results

Get diagnostic assessment status and progress.

Returns the current status, completed sections, and progress percentage
for a diagnostic assessment attempt.

Args:
    attempt_id: UUID of the diagnostic attempt

Returns:
    DiagnosticStatusResponse: Current status and progress information
